lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 8 visible vertical white lines; 6 primary lines are high-contrast and continuous with relatively uniform spacing across the mid-torso, while 2 peripheral lines are fragmented or lower contrast.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line is fragmented into a series of 3 distinct spots; the anterior-most line is truncated and terminates mid-way down the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, positioned between the last solid vertical line and the base of the tail.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: 3 spots within the posterior cluster align horizontally across the upper hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a double-curved lyrate spiral, diverging laterally from the base before curving medially and terminating in upward-facing tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal tips is approximately 3.8 times the pixel width of the horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Lighter ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 10% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal mane extending along the spine; long dark shaggy hair fringe on the throat and ventral torso; bright orange-tan coloration on the lower limbs below the carpal/tarsal joints.
